map.输入身高与体重，计算身体质量指数（BMI），并依据中国成人标准给出体评等级与健康: Enter height and weight to compute body mass index (BMI), and get a body-assessment grade and healthy weight range based on the Chinese adult standard.
map.BMI = 体重(kg) / 身高(m)²；<18.5 偏瘦，18.5–24 正: BMI = weight (kg) / height (m)²; <18.5 underweight, 18.5–24 normal, 24–28 overweight, ≥28 obese.
💡 BMI = weight (kg) ÷ height² (m²). Chinese adult standard: 18.5-23.9 normal, 24-27.9 overweight, ≥28 obese.
map.BMI 不区分肌肉与脂肪，肌肉发达者可能偏高却不超重: BMI does not distinguish muscle from fat; muscular people may score high yet not be overweight
map.本标准适用于 18 岁以上中国成人，儿童孕妇不适用: This standard applies to Chinese adults over 18; it does not apply to children or pregnant women
map.腰围也是重要指标：男≥90cm、女≥85cm 提示中心性肥胖: Waist circumference is also an important indicator: ≥90 cm for men and ≥85 cm for women suggests central obesity
map.结果仅供参考，身体成分请结合体脂率综合判断: Results are for reference only; for body composition, judge together with body-fat percentage

map.可复现算例：175 cm / 70 kg 的 BMI 与理想体重: Reproducible example: BMI and ideal weight for 175 cm / 70 kg
map.输入：身高 175 cm、体重 70 kg。\nBMI=70/(1.75²)=7:
Input: height 175 cm, weight 70 kg.
BMI=70/(1.75²)=70/3.0625=22.86 (normal on the Chinese standard, 18.5–23.9).
Ideal weight range: lower 18.5×3.0625≈56.7 kg, upper 23.9×3.0625≈73.2 kg; the commonly used ideal value is 22×3.0625≈67.4 kg.
Conclusion: 70 kg falls in the healthy range, and a target can be set within 56.7–73.2 kg.
map.中国标准和 WHO 区别？: What is the difference between the Chinese standard and WHO?
map.亚洲人在较低 BMI 即出现代谢风险，故中国标准超重线 24、肥胖线 28，低于: Asians develop metabolic risk at a lower BMI, so the Chinese standard sets the overweight line at 24 and the obesity line at 28, lower than the WHO's 25/30; this tool uses the Chinese standard (18.5–23.9 normal).
map.BMI 正常就健康吗？: Does a normal BMI mean you are healthy?
